note: The Turks and Caicos Islands: nationals of the countries listed stay up to 90 days without a visa; everyone else needs a visa. Holders of a UK, US or Canadian visa or residence need none (not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy (the territory's immigration pages publish no list this client can read). Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Turks and Caicos Islands Government's own table, which names all 77 passports held; the 90 days isn't stated there and stands on Wikipedia's copy. Entry on a UK, US or Canadian visa or residence isn't modelled.

sources.said: Countries and Territories whose Nationals or Citizens Do not require visas for the Turks and Caicos Islands ... Anguilla Lesotho Antigua and Barbuda Lichtenstein Argentina Lithuania ... Taiwan ... United States of America Japan Vatican City Latvia. Nationals of countries and territories not listed in the table above who are lawful residents of the United Kingdom, United States of America or Canada, or who are holders of a valid visa permitting their travel to any of these three countries, may be granted leave to enter the Islands without a Turks and Caicos Islands visa.
